I'm now looking for internships and full-time roles where I can keep building with AI. When I'm not coding, I'm reading research papers, exploring new models and sharpening my full-stack skills.

projects.title: StyleGen AI
projects.subtitle: AI-powered smart fashion stylist
projects.summary: A personal styling assistant that recommends outfits and hairstyles and shows you wearing them, while keeping your face recognisable.
description: StyleGen AI takes a person's photo and preferences such as gender and occasion, then generates personalised style cards covering outfits, colours and hairstyles.
A virtual try-on step uses an image-to-image generative model (Flux 2 Pro via Replicate) with carefully engineered prompts so the generated look preserves the user's facial identity.
The backend is built with FastAPI and Python, and the frontend with React and Vite. The work also led to a co-authored research paper for ICICNS 2026.
highlights: Style cards tailored by gender and occasion, with per-garment colour suggestions
Identity-preserving virtual try-on using image-to-image generation
Structured hairstyle recommendations instead of free-text output
FastAPI backend with a React + Vite frontend

projects.title: Fake News Detection
projects.subtitle: Machine learning text classifier
projects.summary: An NLP model that classifies news articles as real or fake to help fight misinformation.
description: This project trains a machine learning classifier on labelled news data to tell reliable articles from misleading ones.
Text goes through cleaning, tokenisation and feature extraction before being fed to the model, which is then evaluated on held-out data.
highlights: Text preprocessing and feature extraction pipeline
Evaluated with accuracy, precision and recall

projects.title: Sign Language to Text
projects.subtitle: Real-time gesture recognition
projects.summary: Reads hand gestures from a webcam and converts sign language into readable text in real time.
description: This project recognises sign language gestures from a live camera feed and converts them into text, helping bridge the communication gap for people who are deaf or hard of hearing.
Hand landmarks are detected from each frame and passed to a trained model that predicts the sign.
highlights: Hand landmark extraction for robust recognition
Instant text output for each recognised sign
